person.description: Index into persons[]. The filer this benefit statement belongs to — the primary, or the spouse on a joint return.

form_type.description: Which statement reports the benefits: Form SSA-1099 (Social Security) or Form RRB-1099 (the Social Security equivalent portion of Railroad Retirement tier 1). The two number their boxes differently; the amounts below are named without a box number. Required: the engine keys each amount to the form.

net_benefits_cents.description: Net benefits for the year — SSA-1099 box 5 (box 3 benefits paid minus box 4 benefits repaid), or RRB-1099 box 5. Required: the statement is issued because benefits were paid, so a blank box is an unread box, not a benefit of nothing. Reaches Form 1040 lines 6a and 6b and, through them, line 9. Never negative here: repayments exceeding benefits open an itemized deduction (or the dictionary's own knockout above $3,000) that this service does not carry, so a negative is refused rather than served as a negative line 6a.

federal_withholding_cents.description: Voluntary federal income tax withheld — SSA-1099 box 6, or RRB-1099 box 10. Optional: blank is an ordinary state of the box; absent is computed as zero and stated in the response. Reaches Form 1040 line 25b, inside line 25d. Never negative.
